definitions.explanation: A chemical element essential for breathing and combustion.

examples.japanese: {高山|こうざん}では{酸素|さんそ}が{薄|うす}いため、{体調|たいちょう}{管理|かんり}に{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: In high mountains, oxygen is thin, so one needs to be careful about health management.

notes:
{酸素|さんそ} is the chemical element oxygen (O). The kanji mean {酸|さん} (acid) + {素|そ} (element).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {酸素|さんそ}マスク: oxygen mask
- {酸素|さんそ}ボンベ: oxygen tank/cylinder
- {酸素|さんそ}{濃度|のうど}: oxygen concentration
- {酸素|さんそ}{不足|ぶそく}: oxygen deficiency
- {酸素|さんそ}{供給|きょうきゅう}: oxygen supply

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酸素|さんそ}が{薄|うす}い: oxygen is thin (at high altitudes)
- {酸素|さんそ}を{吸|す}う: to breathe in oxygen

RELATED ELEMENTS:
- {水素|すいそ}: hydrogen (H)
- {窒素|ちっそ}: nitrogen (N)
- {炭素|たんそ}: carbon (C)
- {二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}: carbon dioxide (CO₂)
